about_the_game:
HABROMANIA

(n.) Delusions of happiness

Alice must have been falling for at least an hour. Or maybe longer- Alice has never been very good at keeping time. But the wind rushes in her hair, yanking at her clothes, and it's almost like she's flying. It's glorious.

Until she hits the ground.

HABROMANIA is a dreamy (or nightmarish) Alice in Wonderland-inspired RPG that follows 19-year-old Alice as she tries to escape the surreal, cozy hellscape that is Wonderland—hopefully with her sanity intact. Alice wakes up at the bottom of a hole with a pounding headache and no memories of how she landed there- or memories in general, actually.

She can't remember her past, but she knows that she needs to get out of here, wherever here is. Guide Alice as she attempts to escape Wonderland, navigating lush, hand-drawn environments and the socially incompetent characters who inhabit them, all with their own complex pasts and varied moral compasses, including:

  • The Cat, an enigmatic, perpetually grinning cat(?) who seems a little too eager to help her,

  • Hatter, an endlessly chatty, erratic, charming tea-enthusiast  who is woefully hung up over his ex-girlfriend,

  • The Queen of Hearts, the previously mentioned ex, who wants revenge almost as badly as she wants to get the hell out of this place,

and so so so so so (so!) many more friendly, awful people!

  • Explore immersive, maximalist environments jam-packed with interactables and collectibles, accompanied by an original OST played on an out-of-tune piano

  • Make Choices through branching dialogue and a karma system that determines the fate of the creatures of Wonderland and Alice herself,

  • Collect Very Interesting And Useful things that aid in puzzle-solving, bartering, and uncovering the deeper lore of Wonderland and the people there

  • Uncover the past and the truth about Wonderland before Alice loses her head (or her mind)

HABROMANIA is a narrative-driven game with 12 "chapters" and multiple endings. Chapters will be released continuously with game updates.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th Gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and keyboard input required
